bug_semantics: An MCP caller can select smart_user operation=get-user-info and supply an attacker-controlled username. SmartUser.run dispatches to getUserInfo, which passes options.username to getUserDetails; on Unix that method interpolated the username into `getent passwd "${username}" || grep "^${username}:" /etc/passwd` and executed the string with promisified child_process.exec. POSIX command substitution remains active inside double quotes, so `$(...)` or backticks in username execute commands with the MCP server process's privileges.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable smart-user implementation first appears in this target repository in fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff, but that 69,886-line, 160-file commit expressly says it integrated 367 TypeScript files from the pre-existing hypercontext-mcp project. It is an aggregate external-source import, not the commit that originally authored the vulnerable shell interpolation. The true smallest BIC is therefore behind the unavailable hypercontext source-history boundary rather than a target-repository commit.
